maintenance_led.reason: Sells Suboxone film and Sublocade injection for opioid use disorder; prescription drugs, not repair or servicing of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Sublocade and Suboxone are largely paid by Medicaid and Medicare in the US, though commercial insurers also pay.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by selling its own OUD products such as Sublocade and Suboxone and by developing new ones, not by regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Patients stabilised on Sublocade or Suboxone face clinical risk of relapse if switched; branded, regulated, prescriber-managed treatment.

notes: Medicaid share of revenue is from general knowledge, not from the website text, so the funding answer is less certain.
